summary: BioHarvest Sciences Inc. filed a Form 6-K (material change report) on May 13, 2026, announcing the successful completion of Stage 1 development of a saffron composition for nutraceutical and culinary applications under a CDMO agreement with SaffronTech. The development agreement is valued at $1.125 million, with Stage 1 triggering advancement to Stage 2. BioHarvest holds a 25% ownership position in the saffron composition and will receive future commercial manufacturing royalties. This is a routine business development milestone, not a special situation, as it does not involve an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or management change.
